tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, captions, metadata. At least 5.5:1 on bg-000 and bg-200.

tokens.name: accent

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Accent under the pointer.

tokens.name: on-accent

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring drawn 3px outside the control. 3:1+ against the canvas.

tokens.name: success
